messages:
maya: Heads-up — saw a spike of 503s in staging around 23:58 UTC, likely KV cache regen. Thinking a small hotfix image push tonight in the 00:10 UTC short window. Ping for expedited approvals.
liam: Can you confirm blast radius? which clusters affected?
sasha: staging eu-west1 and ci-staging, prod not yet but we should treat as urgent. What change in the image?
maya: quick change: tokenizer shard fallback + kvcache short-circuit. small binary bump only. image tag: `redwood/inference:v2026.03.21-kvhotfix`
noah: ok. rollback plan: standard blue/green and immediate pin to `v2026.03.20-stable` if errors >1% 5m. Also can flip traffic to standby EU pool.
deploy-bot: deploy request created by maya: `/deploy prod eu-west1 inference v2026.03.21-kvhotfix --window 00:10-00:20 --require-approvals 2` (approval_count=0)
maya: @liam @sasha can you +1? I'll run post-deploy smoke.
liam: +1 :thumbsup:
sasha: +1 — oncall please acknowledge window and hold if latency rises.
oncall: oncall here, standing by for the window. If p95 latency >120ms or errors >0.5% roll back. Will monitor logs and traces.
maya: deploy-bot, schedule at 00:12 UTC please.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: 00:12 UTC. Required approvals: 2/2.
ops-bot: Reminder: release-notes draft needed before cut — `release-notes/quick/kvcache-fallback.md` created.
00:12 UTC — deploy-bot: starting rolling deploy to prod eu-west1 (batch size 10%)
noah: seeing a few 500s at 10% — holding the rollout at batch 1, pausing.
liam: capture logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference --since=2m | grep -i error`
noah: pasted snippet: ```
ERROR tokenizer: shard mismatch: expected 8 got 6
at tokenizer/shard.go:84
```
sasha: that smells like build-time artifact mismatch. Did the image include an old tokenizer binary?
maya: hmm — CI packaging maybe pulled wrong artifact. We should abort and rollback.
deploy-bot: rollout paused by noah (reason: runtime errors). 00:13 UTC
noah: triggering rollback to `v2026.03.20-stable` now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by noah — starting traffic shift back to previous version
00:15 UTC — deploy-bot: rollback complete. Production traffic restored to `v2026.03.20-stable`.
oncall: verified p95 back to baseline. no further action from oncall.
maya: filing root cause: CI artifact tag mismatch + missing smoke check for tokenizer binary. Will open postmortem and revert release-notes to mark reverted hotfix.
liam: filing JIRA INF-1234 for CI fix and INF-1235 for improved pre-cut smoke.
sasha: quick checklist: 1) disable auto-promote from CI until artifact hashes verified, 2) add tokenizer binary checksum in smoke run.
maya: thanks all — appreciate the fast responses. We'll aim to reschedule after CI fixes; keeping the short window blocked for 24h. :handshake:
